title: AnimaWatch settings
description: Settings for your own AnimaWatch MCP server. Frame timing, screenshots and Core Web Vitals need no key. The AI vision pass uses your own Gemini API key, or is off.

geminiApiKey.title: Gemini API key (optional)
geminiApiKey.description: Your own Google Gemini API key, for the AI vision pass. Stored encrypted. If you or your users are in the UK, the EEA or Switzerland, Google's terms require a paid (billing-enabled) key. Leave empty to turn vision off.

visionEnabled.title: Use AI vision
visionEnabled.description: Review recordings and screenshots with Gemini. Needs a key above.

visionModel.title: Gemini model
visionModel.description: Gemini model for the vision pass. It must accept video.

maxWaitSeconds.title: Longest wait per call (seconds)
maxWaitSeconds.description: Upper bound on how long one tool call waits or measures after loading a page.
